name: unreal
description: Unreal Engine 5 traps a model gets wrong from memory — UE 5.8 Zen Server as the default cooked output store (Saved/Cooked holds only ue.projectstore), the 5.8 Visual Studio/MSVC/Windows SDK/Xcode minimums, Enhanced Input mapping contexts that fail on clients and player-mappable key rebinding through User Settings, headless automation tests, UObjects held from plain C++, and Behavior Tree node memory.

cc_unreal_check.title: Project check after a Config or Source edit (CC_UNREAL_CHECK)
cc_unreal_check.description: Run check_unreal_project.py after a Write or Edit of a Config/*.ini or Source/**/*.cpp|h under the nearest .uproject, and add that file's findings: on or off. The environment variable CC_UNREAL_CHECK overrides this.
